meta.title: Better plan preview
meta.description: Read DSH plans in an Antigravity-style document view in Better Sidebar, with paragraph comments on active reviews and graded plan-mode structure guidance. Requires Better Sidebar 0.32.1; approval still uses the native DSH controls.

ui.failed: Could not read this plan from session history.
ui.retry: Close this tab and reopen the plan from its card to try again.
ui.reopen: Return to the pending review and choose View full plan.
ui.fileUnavailable: Could not open this file in Better Sidebar.
ui.mermaidZoomHint: Scroll to zoom · Drag to pan · Esc to close
ui.mermaidError: Could not render Mermaid diagram; showing source.
ui.annotationHint: Select text within one paragraph or list item, then choose Add comment beside the selection or in the toolbar.
ui.annotationSelectionInvalid: Select text within one paragraph or list item, excluding diagrams, code blocks, tables, and math.
ui.annotationQuoteLimit: Select a shorter excerpt (up to 400 characters).
ui.annotationLocationUnavailable: Could not find that block in this plan.
ui.annotationCountLimit: You can save up to 10 comments for this review.
ui.annotationCommentLimit: Shorten this comment to 800 characters or fewer.
ui.annotationEditChanged: This comment has changed. Cancel and reopen it to edit the latest version.
ui.annotationDraftWarning: Only Continue planning with comments sends your comments. Reloading the page or ending the review discards unsent comments.
ui.annotationReviewUnavailable: This plan is no longer waiting for this review.
ui.annotationSent: Comments sent; waiting for DSH to process them.
ui.annotationSendFailed: Could not send the comments. Your draft is still here; try again.
